title: Lamina - (thin glass)
description: Adds thinn copper layed glass to minecraft 1.21.1, inspired by ContentSMP
body:
# Lamina
**Adds thinn copper layed glass to minecraft 1.21.1, inspired by ContentSMP's [ContentContent](https://modrinth.com/mod/contentcontent) mod.**

## Features:
- Adds thin glass to minecraft!
- Fake connecting texture (since only the rim is visable)
- Waterlogable! (makes for the perfect slimm aquarium! 
- Has a Crafting recipe:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b01c50210b78a2c12109c76d213d7d7b4d8e204.png)

</details>



## Basic idea of this mod:
While watching [doctor4t](https://www.youtube.com/@doctor4t)'s decorate, and [talon](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ijyETxywRQ&t=1747s)'s bace tour i noticed some thinn glass they had, so I decided to make something similar for my preffered version of minecraft since nothing existed!

## IF ANY ISUES ARISE
Please report them in my [Discord](https://discord.gg/Y8NA8hwuwC) server, thanks! <3
